assertion_presets.description: Check that the replay output run succeeded, has no failed spans, and has enough spans.
assertion_presets.name: replay_success_shape

assertion_presets.description: Check that the replay output run contains at least one handoff.
assertion_presets.name: replay_handoff_present

deterministic_assertions.description: Check that the baseline target is not failed, or that a replay-mapped target improves from failed to not failed.
deterministic_assertions.name: target_status_not_failed

deterministic_assertions.description: Check a decoded field on the replay target mapped from the baseline evidence.
deterministic_assertions.name: replay_target_field_equals

deterministic_assertions.description: Find a replay output entity and compare a decoded field.
deterministic_assertions.name: replay_entity_field_equals

deterministic_assertions.description: Check the replay output run status.
deterministic_assertions.name: replay_run_status_equals

deterministic_assertions.description: Check that the replay output run has no failed spans.
deterministic_assertions.name: replay_no_failed_spans

deterministic_assertions.description: Check that the replay output run has at least the requested number of spans.
deterministic_assertions.name: replay_span_count_at_least

deterministic_assertions.description: Check that the replay output run has at least the requested number of handoffs.
deterministic_assertions.name: replay_handoff_count_at_least

check_types.name: deterministic_assertion
check_types.notes: Runs concrete assertions over stored source evidence and optional completed replay evidence.

check_types.name: judge
check_types.notes: Executes recorded pass/fail verdicts only. Live/provider judges must use explicit judge-command capture first.

check_types.name: regression_replay
check_types.notes: Requires completed bounded replay evidence and fail-before/pass-after proof.

check_types.name: smoke_run
check_types.notes: Runs informational checks over an already-recorded source run or replay output run.
